about: Expand Energy is the largest US natural gas producer, formed in 2024 by the merger of Chesapeake Energy and Southwestern Energy and renamed from Chesapeake. Headquartered in Oklahoma City and listed on Nasdaq (EXE), it produces over 7 billion cubic feet of gas equivalent per day from the Appalachian Basin and Haynesville shale, selling to utilities, LNG exporters and marketers. Revenue is gas and liquids sales, several billion dollars annually. B2B upstream producer with little consumer brand awareness.

Genesis Energy is a Houston-based midstream master limited partnership listed on the NYSE (GEL). It owns pipelines, offshore Gulf of Mexico crude oil transportation, sodium minerals (soda ash) and trona mining in Wyoming, and marine transportation, serving oil producers, refiners and industrial buyers. Revenue is fees and mineral sales. Founded 1996. B2B energy infrastructure and minerals company with little public brand awareness.

Golar LNG is a Bermuda-based, London-managed provider of floating LNG infrastructure, listed on Nasdaq (GLNG). It owns and operates FLNG vessels such as Hilli Episeyo and Gimi, converting natural gas into LNG offshore for producers in locations like Cameroon and Mauritania/Senegal, and previously owned FSRUs and LNG carriers. Customers are oil and gas companies, paying long-term tolling fees. Founded 2001, linked to Hemen Holding (John Fredriksen). B2B shipping and energy business, no consumer brand.

Keyera is a Canadian midstream energy company headquartered in Calgary and listed on the TSX (KEY), operating natural gas gathering and processing plants, NGL fractionation and storage, and an iso-octane facility across Western Canada. In 2025 it agreed to acquire Plains All American's Canadian NGL business. Customers are producers and industrial users, paying fees. Founded 1998 from Pembina and others. B2B energy infrastructure operator with little consumer awareness.

Kodiak Gas Services is a US contract compression provider headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas and listed on the NYSE (KGS). It owns and operates one of the largest fleets of natural gas compression units, serving producers and midstream companies mainly in the Permian Basin, Eagle Ford and Haynesville under long-term fee-based contracts. Revenue is around 1.2 billion dollars. Backed by private equity firm EQT before going public in 2023. B2B energy services with no consumer brand.

Naturgy is a Spanish integrated gas and electricity utility headquartered in Madrid, listed on the Spanish stock exchange (NTGY). It supplies natural gas and electricity to around 15 million customers in Spain, Latin America and elsewhere, operates networks and renewable power generation and has a large global LNG business. Revenue is roughly 22 billion euros. Formerly Gas Natural Fenosa, renamed 2018. Major shareholders include CVC, GIP and Criteria Caixa. Established consumer energy brand in Spain with football and sports sponsorships.

New Fortress Energy is a US energy infrastructure company headquartered in New York, listed on Nasdaq (NFE), that builds LNG terminals, floating storage and regasification units and gas-fired power plants, selling LNG to power plants and industrial users in the Caribbean, Latin America, Brazil and elsewhere. Founded 2014 by Wes Edens, it has expanded through Hygo and GasLog deals and ownership of fast LNG projects. Revenue is around 2 billion dollars; financially stressed in 2025. B2B energy firm with no consumer brand.

QatarEnergy, formerly Qatar Petroleum, is the state-owned oil and gas company of Qatar, headquartered in Doha, and one of the world's largest LNG producers with capacity of 77 million tonnes a year, being expanded to about 142 million. It also operates upstream fields, petrochemicals, fertilisers and shipping, and holds international stakes in projects such as Golden Pass LNG. Founded 1974; wholly owned by the Government of Qatar. B2B energy giant, a long-time sponsor of sport and events in the Gulf.

Sunoco LP is a Dallas-based master limited partnership listed on the NYSE (SUN) and one of the largest US wholesale motor fuel distributors, supplying around 10,000 convenience stores, independent dealers and commercial customers across more than 40 states. It also owns terminals and pipelines, including the NuStar assets acquired in 2024. Revenue is more than 20 billion dollars, mostly pass-through fuel sales. Managed by Energy Transfer. Sunoco-branded fuel is also known to US drivers and a long-time NASCAR race fuel supplier.

Transocean is a Swiss-based offshore contract drilling company with its registered office in Zug and operating headquarters in Switzerland and Houston, listed on the NYSE (RIG). It owns and operates a fleet of ultra-deepwater and harsh-environment drilling rigs and drillships, hired by oil majors and national oil companies. Revenue is day-rate contracts, around 3 billion dollars. Founded 1973. B2B oilfield services company with no consumer brand.

USA Compression Partners is a Texas-based master limited partnership listed on the NYSE (USAC), providing natural gas compression services on fee-based contracts to producers, gatherers and processors in the Permian, Marcellus and other shale basins. It has one of the largest compression fleets in the US at roughly 3.7 million horsepower, and is controlled by Energy Transfer. Revenue is about 900 million dollars. Founded 1998. B2B energy services firm with no consumer brand.

Vedanta is a diversified Indian natural resources group in the Anil Agarwal family, with Vedanta Resources in London and operating Vedanta Limited listed in India, headquartered in Mumbai. It produces zinc, lead, silver, aluminium, copper, iron ore, oil and gas and steel in India, Africa and Namibia, with revenue of roughly 17 billion dollars. Its subsidiary Hindustan Zinc is the world's largest integrated zinc producer. Founded 1976. Mainly B2B; Cairn and Hindustan Zinc and others sponsor sport. A 2025 demerger split the group into several listed units.

Viper Energy is a Midland, Texas-based mineral and royalty company, a subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, listed on Nasdaq (VNOM). It owns royalty interests in Permian Basin oil and gas land, receiving a share of production without bearing drilling costs, and has expanded with acquisitions including Sitio Royalties in 2025. Revenue is royalties, around 1 billion dollars. Formed 2014. B2B energy royalty vehicle with no consumer profile.

VoltaGrid is a Houston-area (Bellaire, Texas) company that provides mobile, modular natural-gas-fired power generation for oilfields, data centres and industrial users, delivering power as a service. It has supply agreements with large AI and cloud customers and has raised large funding rounds and large data centre power agreements. Founded 2022. B2B power provider with no consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Wabash Valley Resources is an Indiana energy company in West Terre Haute that is developing a coal-gasification plant converting petroleum coke and coal into ammonia, with carbon capture and storage to produce low-carbon fertiliser and hydrogen. It has raised investment from energy and infrastructure funds and secured federal support. Customers would be fertiliser and industrial buyers. B2B project developer with no public brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Western Midstream Partners is a Texas master limited partnership based in The Woodlands, listed on the NYSE (WES) and sponsored by Occidental Petroleum. It gathers, processes and transports natural gas, crude oil and produced water for producers in the Delaware Basin, DJ Basin and other regions, with revenue near 3.5 billion dollars. Fee-based contracts with Occidental and others. Formed 2008 as Anadarko Midstream. B2B energy infrastructure with no consumer brand.

Yinson Production is the floating production storage and offloading (FPSO) arm of Malaysian group Yinson Holdings, headquartered in Singapore. It owns and operates FPSOs on long-term charters in Ghana, Brazil, Angola, Nigeria and Asia for oil majors and national oil companies. The Yinson Holdings parent is listed on Bursa Malaysia, controlled by the Lim family. B2B offshore energy services with no consumer profile.

National Grid is a British multinational electricity and gas utility headquartered in London and listed on the LSE and NYSE (NG.). It owns and operates the high-voltage electricity transmission network in England and Wales, gas transmission, and regulated electricity and gas distribution in the northeast US (New York, Massachusetts), plus interconnectors and renewable investments, serving millions of customers with revenue near 20 billion pounds. Consumer-facing in the US and UK as a utility; extensive green energy sponsorship profile, including Extreme E.

ADNOC, the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, is the state-owned energy group of Abu Dhabi, covering onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration and production, refining, petrochemicals via Borouge, gas processing, and fuel retail through ADNOC Distribution. It produces around 4 million barrels of oil per day and has subsidiaries including ADNOC Drilling, ADNOC Gas and XRG. Wholly owned by the Abu Dhabi government. Several subsidiaries are listed on ADX. Very high brand profile in the Gulf.

about: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil and gas company, producing about 2.7 million barrels of oil equivalent per day, largely from deep-water pre-salt fields, with refining, fuel distribution, gas and growing renewables. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The Brazilian federal government holds the voting control. Listed on B3 (PETR3/PETR4) and NYSE (PBR). Revenue is around $90 billion. Very high brand profile in Brazil, with a long history of sponsoring Brazilian sport and motorsport.

Bapco Energies is the Bahrain state-owned oil and gas holding company, the successor to Bapco, running the Sitra refinery, fuel distribution and retail through Bapco Energies Retail stations, Bahrain Petroleum, Tatweer Petroleum and Bapco Gas. It operates under the Bahrain government, with the Sitra refinery expansion project financed by about $4 billion of loans. It is a major national employer. Well-known in Bahrain.

Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) is a large Indian state-controlled oil refiner and marketer, with refineries at Mumbai, Kochi and Bina and a retail network of over 20,000 petrol stations, plus LPG (Bharatgas), lubricants, aviation fuel and a growing gas and renewables business. Headquartered in Mumbai, with revenue over $50 billion. The Government of India holds a majority stake. Listed on NSE and BSE (BPCL). Very strong consumer brand in India, with sports sponsorship including cricket.

Castleton Commodities International (CCI) is a Stamford, Connecticut commodities merchant trading and producing physical oil, gas, power and refined products, and owning upstream oil and gas assets through Castleton Resources and storage. Launched in 2011 with Carlyle backing. Customers are producers, utilities and industrial buyers. Private. B2B trader with little public brand awareness.

Enterprise Products Partners is one of the largest US midstream energy companies, running natural gas, NGL, crude oil, petrochemical and refined products pipelines, storage, export terminals and processing plants. Customers are producers, refiners, petrochemical makers and export buyers, paid through fee-based services. Headquartered in Houston, Texas. Structured as a master limited partnership listed on NYSE (EPD), with market value above $60 billion. B2B infrastructure, with little consumer brand awareness.

Hess Midstream is a Houston-based midstream company that gathers, processes and compresses natural gas, handles crude oil and water services, and operates terminals mainly for Hess Corporation's Bakken production in North Dakota. Revenue is fee-based under long-term contracts with Hess, now part of Chevron after the 2025 acquisition. Structured as an MLP and later converted to a C-corp, listed on NYSE (HESM). B2B infrastructure, little public brand awareness.

Kinetik is a Permian Basin midstream company that gathers, compresses, processes and transports natural gas, crude oil and produced water, with pipelines and processing plants in Texas and New Mexico. Customers are oil and gas producers, with revenue from fee-based contracts. Headquartered in Midland, Texas, formed in 2022 through the combination of Altus Midstream and BCP Raptor. Listed on NYSE (KNTK). B2B, little consumer brand awareness.

Nabors Industries is one of the world's largest land drilling contractors, providing rigs, drilling services, drilling automation software and tools such as Canrig, plus offshore platform drilling, serving oil and gas producers in the US, Middle East, Latin America and Asia. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with a Bermuda legal domicile, and revenue of about $3 billion. Acquired Parker Wellbore in 2024. Listed on NYSE (NBR). B2B, low consumer visibility.

Pembina Pipeline is a Calgary-based Canadian energy infrastructure company that transports and processes crude oil and natural gas liquids, runs gas gathering and processing plants and export terminals, and has a stake in Cedar LNG. Customers are oil and gas producers and shippers on fee-based contracts, with revenue of about C$8 billion. Founded in 1954. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (PBA). B2B energy company with local recognition in Alberta.

Permian Resources is a US independent oil and gas producer focused on the Delaware Basin in the Permian, producing about 350,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Customers are refiners and midstream buyers, with revenue from oil and gas sales. Headquartered in Midland, Texas, formed in 2022 through the merger of Centennial Resource Development and Colgate Energy. Listed on NYSE (PR). B2B energy producer, little consumer brand awareness.

Plains All American Pipeline is a Houston-based midstream company that transports, stores and markets crude oil and natural gas liquids, with thousands of miles of pipelines, storage terminals and rail and truck assets, mostly in the Permian Basin and across North America. Customers are producers and refiners, with revenue largely fee-based plus marketing. Structured as a master limited partnership, with units listed on Nasdaq (PAA). B2B, little consumer awareness.

Plug Power is a hydrogen fuel cell company providing green hydrogen production, electrolyzers, liquid hydrogen and fuel cell systems for forklifts and material handling, with customers including Amazon and Walmart. Headquartered in Latham, New York, founded in 1997. It has reported heavy losses and raised substantial capital. Listed on Nasdaq (PLUG). B2B brand, known to investors and in clean energy, with limited consumer awareness.

TC Energy is a Calgary-based North American energy infrastructure company operating natural gas pipelines, including the NGTL and Columbia systems and the Mexico network, plus power generation, storage and nuclear interests, with revenue of about C$14 billion. It spun off its liquids business as South Bow in 2024. Customers are producers, utilities and power buyers. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (TRP). B2B infrastructure, with limited consumer awareness.

Woodside Energy is Australia's largest oil and gas company, producing LNG from the North West Shelf, Pluto and Scarborough developments, plus oil in the Gulf of Mexico and Trinidad and Tobago, and developing the Louisiana LNG project in the US. Headquartered in Perth, founded in 1954. It merged with BHP's petroleum business in 2022. Customers are LNG buyers in Asia and Europe. Listed on the ASX (WDS) and NYSE. Corporate brand with strong Australian sport and community sponsorship.

Methanex is the world's largest producer and supplier of methanol, a chemical used to make plastics, paints, adhesives, fuels and other products, with plants in New Zealand, Trinidad, Egypt, Chile, Canada and the US, and a global shipping fleet. Customers are chemical and energy companies, with revenue of about $4 billion. Headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Listed on the TSX (MX) and Nasdaq (MEOH). B2B commodity chemical supplier with no consumer brand awareness.

Aetherion Technologies is a Vancouver, British Columbia based clean transportation technology company, according to Crunchbase, working across automotive, energy and oil and gas. It has raised about $642 million in total funding as shown. Its specific products, customers and ownership are not stated in the data available. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) is Kuwait's state-owned oil company, controlling upstream production, refining, petrochemicals, tankers and international marketing through subsidiaries such as Kuwait Oil Company, Kuwait National Petroleum Company and Kuwait Petroleum International, which runs the Q8 brand across Europe. Wholly owned by the government of Kuwait. Customers are refiners, traders and drivers at Q8 stations. Not listed. Q8 is a recognised fuel brand in parts of Europe.

Var Energi is the largest independent exploration and production company on the Norwegian continental shelf, producing roughly 250,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day from fields such as Goliat, Balder and Ormen Lange. Headquartered in Sandnes, Rogaland. Owned mainly by Eni and HitecVision, and listed on Oslo Bors (VAR) since 2022. Customers are refiners and gas buyers across Europe. B2B energy producer, with little consumer brand awareness.

Ecopetrol is Colombia's largest integrated oil and gas company, operating production, refining, pipelines through Cenit, petrochemicals and renewable energy, with ISA transmission networks as a subsidiary and operations in Brazil, Peru and the US Permian Basin. Headquartered in Bogota, with the Colombian government holding about 88 percent. Listed on the Colombian exchange (ECOPETROL) and NYSE (EC). Revenue is around $30 billion. Well-known national brand with a history of sports sponsorship in Colombia.

Neste is a Finnish refiner and a leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel from waste and residue oils, with refineries in Finland, the Netherlands and Singapore, plus oil products and polymer solutions. Customers are airlines, fuel distributors, transport companies and chemical makers, with revenue of about 20 billion euros. Headquartered in Espoo, with the Finnish state owning about 44 percent. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (NESTE). Well known in Finland and a long-time rally sponsor, including Rally Finland.

Orlen, formerly PKN Orlen, is a Polish multi-energy group that operates refineries and petrochemical plants, produces oil and gas, generates power, and runs about 3,000 fuel stations in Poland, Germany, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary and Lithuania. It merged with Lotos and PGNiG in 2022. Headquartered in Plock, with the Polish state as the largest shareholder. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PKN). Strong consumer fuel brand in Poland with a history in motorsport, including Robert Kubica and Alfa Romeo Racing Orlen.

PPC Group, formerly Public Power Corporation, is Greece's largest electricity company, generating power from lignite, gas, hydro and growing renewables, and supplying and distributing electricity to millions of customers in Greece, Romania, Bulgaria and other Balkan markets, plus fibre broadband and EV charging. Headquartered in Athens, with the Greek state a major shareholder (about 34 percent). Listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (PPC). Well-known national consumer brand in Greece.

Weatherford International is an oilfield services company providing drilling, well construction, completions, production and intervention technology, such as managed pressure drilling and artificial lift, in about 75 countries. Customers are national and international oil and gas companies, with revenue of about $5 billion. Legally domiciled in Ireland (Dublin) and operationally headquartered in Houston, Texas. Listed on Nasdaq (WFRD). B2B energy services brand with no consumer awareness.

YPF is Argentina's largest energy company, producing oil and gas, notably from the Vaca Muerta shale formation, refining, selling fuels at its national network of YPF service stations and Elaion lubricants, and operating petrochemicals and power. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, with the Argentine state owning about 51 percent after the 2012 renationalisation. Listed on NYSE (YPF) and BYMA. Very visible consumer fuel brand in Argentina with long ties to national motorsport.

Atlas Energy Solutions produces and delivers proppant (frac sand) and logistics services to oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico, using local mines and a last-mile logistics system. Headquartered in Austin, Texas. Customers are exploration and production companies and oilfield service firms. Listed on NYSE (AESI) since its 2023 IPO. B2B, with little consumer brand awareness.

Brazos Midstream is a Fort Worth, Texas midstream company that gathers and processes natural gas, crude oil and produced water, with assets mainly in the Delaware Basin of West Texas and New Mexico. Customers are oil and gas producers, with fee-based revenue. Crunchbase shows about $1.9 billion in funding, which likely includes private equity and debt. Private. B2B energy infrastructure, with no consumer awareness.

about: Calumet manufactures and sells specialty petroleum products such as lubricating oils, solvents, waxes and asphalt, and through Montana Renewables produces renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, with refineries in Louisiana, Texas, Montana and Wisconsin. Customers are industrial, consumer product and fuel buyers. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Listed on Nasdaq (CLMT). B2B brand with limited consumer awareness.

Diversified Energy Company acquires and operates mature, low-decline natural gas and oil wells, mainly in the Appalachian Basin, and has expanded to Oklahoma, Louisiana and Texas, producing about 800 million cubic feet of gas equivalent per day. Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, with its roots in the UK. Listed on NYSE (DEC) and the London Stock Exchange (DEC). B2B energy producer, little consumer brand awareness.

Enbridge Westcoast natural gas pipeline system is the British Columbia natural gas gathering, processing and transmission network operated by Calgary-based pipeline giant Enbridge, in this entry a joint venture or minority stake structure. Enbridge itself is listed on the TSX and NYSE (ENB). B2B energy infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness.

B2B brand, known in energy and investing, with no consumer awareness.

Kosmos Energy is a Dallas-based independent oil and gas exploration and production company focused on offshore West Africa (Ghana, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania and Senegal) and the US Gulf of America, with the Jubilee and Tortue LNG projects. Customers are oil traders and gas buyers. Founded in 2003, with Warburg Pincus and Blackstone as early backers. Listed on NYSE (KOS). B2B energy producer, no consumer awareness.

MET Group is a Swiss-based international energy company, based in Baar, trading and supplying natural gas and electricity and developing renewable energy, with customers across Europe, particularly in Central and Southeast Europe. B2B fuel producer with no consumer awareness.

Northern Oil and Gas is a Minnetonka, Minnesota company that acquires non-operated minority interests in oil and natural gas wells, mainly in the Williston, Permian, Appalachian and Uinta basins, partnering with operators rather than drilling itself. Revenue comes from its share of production, at about $2 billion. Listed on NYSE American (NOG). Investor-focused brand with no consumer awareness.

about: Budapest-based Hungarian oil, gas and fuel retail group, operating refineries and about 2,000 filling stations in Central and Eastern Europe. Listed in Budapest (MOL). Revenue is about EUR 20 billion. Strong consumer brand in Hungary and neighbouring countries. Operates in Hungary, Slovakia, Croatia, Romania and other markets, with about 25,000 employees. MOL is also active in petrochemicals and has exploration assets in Azerbaijan, Kurdistan and elsewhere, and its fuel stations are present across eleven countries.

EIG Pearl Holdings is the investment vehicle through which a consortium led by US energy investor EIG acquired a 49 percent stake in Aramco Oil Pipelines Company in 2021, in a deal worth about 12.4 billion dollars, with Saudi Aramco retaining majority control. The Pearl Pipelines network carries crude oil across Saudi Arabia, and returns come from tariffs paid by Aramco under a long-term lease. Based in Dhahran. B2B infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness.

Pemex (Petroleos Mexicanos) is Mexico's state-owned oil and gas company, headquartered in Mexico City, that explores, refines and distributes crude oil, natural gas and petrochemicals, and operates the Pemex fuel station franchise network. It is among the world's most indebted oil companies and a large contributor to government revenue. Mexican consumers know it through its petrol stations. Employees number over 100,000. Government-owned, with a history of sponsorship in Mexican sport and motorsport, including with Sergio Perez.

ADES International Holding is a Saudi-based offshore and onshore oil and gas drilling and production services provider, headquartered in Al Khobar, operating a fleet of jack-up rigs and land rigs in the Gulf, India, Southeast Asia and elsewhere. Customers include Saudi Aramco and other national oil companies. It is listed on the Saudi Exchange (ADES), has several thousand employees, and acquired Shelf Drilling in 2025. B2B oilfield contractor with no consumer brand awareness.

Dangote Petroleum Refinery is a 650,000-barrel-per-day oil refinery and petrochemical complex in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, Nigeria, owned by Aliko Dangote's Dangote Industries and the largest single-train refinery in the world. It began producing petrol and diesel in 2024 and 2025, supplying the Nigerian market and exporting. Construction cost about 20 billion dollars. The Dangote name is very widely known in Nigeria and across Africa, and the group has sponsored major sports.

Equinor is Norway's state-controlled energy company, headquartered in Stavanger, a major producer of oil and natural gas on the Norwegian continental shelf, with a growing offshore wind and low-carbon business. It was formerly Statoil, renamed in 2018 and is listed on Oslo and the NYSE (EQNR), with the Norwegian state holding about two-thirds. Revenue is over 100 billion dollars. Sells fuel to consumers in Norway through retail stations and has been a sports sponsor, including cycling and football.

PipeBox is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania energy midstream joint venture in the oil and gas sector, according to Crunchbase. Funding of about 3.5 billion dollars is shown. Its partners, assets and operations are not clear from the input, and the name could refer to different entities. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: SK E&S is South Korea's largest private LNG and city gas and power group, a subsidiary of SK Inc., which develops LNG terminals, gas power, renewables, hydrogen and data centre energy solutions, and holds interests in the US and Australia. Headquartered in Seoul, it was merged into SK Innovation in 2025. Customers are utilities, industries and city gas users. Revenue is in the tens of trillions of won. Corporate B2B brand, with the wider SK name well known in Korea.

Southern Company is a US utility holding company based in Atlanta, owning Georgia Power, Alabama Power, Mississippi Power, Southern Power and gas distribution utilities, serving about 9 million electricity and gas customers across the Southeast. It operates nuclear plants including Vogtle units 3 and 4, and is listed on the NYSE (SO), with revenue around 26 billion dollars. Regulated utility with strong regional brand recognition and event sponsorships in the Southeast.

Ascent Resources is a US natural gas producer headquartered in Oklahoma City, focused on the Utica Shale in Ohio, and one of the largest private gas producers in the country. It was co-founded by former Chesapeake chief Aubrey McClendon and is backed by First Reserve. Customers are gas pipelines, utilities and marketers. B2B energy producer with no consumer brand awareness.

HF Sinclair is a US independent petroleum refiner and marketer formed in 2022 by the merger of HollyFrontier and Sinclair Oil, with refineries in the Mid-Continent, Southwest and Rockies, plus lubricants and specialty products. Based in Dallas (Crunchbase shows Minnesota). It is listed on the NYSE (DINO) and its Sinclair brand, with the green dinosaur logo, covers around 1,500 branded gas stations across the US. Revenue is around 30 billion dollars. Moderate consumer recognition in the western US.

Marathon Petroleum is the largest US petroleum refiner, headquartered in Findlay, Ohio, with 13 refineries and about 3 million barrels per day capacity, supplying fuel through its Speedway-origin brands, pipelines via MPLX and retail stations under the Marathon brand. Listed on the NYSE (MPC), with revenue of over 130 billion dollars. Customers range from motorists and distributors to industrial buyers. Strong brand in the US Midwest and Southeast, with extensive sponsorship activity including motorsport.

Repsol Exploracion y Produccion (Repsol E&P) is the upstream oil and gas arm of Spanish energy group Repsol, headquartered in Madrid, exploring for and producing oil and gas in North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, the North Sea and North Africa, with production of about 550,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Parent Repsol is listed on the Spanish stock exchange (REP). B2B upstream arm, while the Repsol brand is a household fuel and lubricants name in Spain and a long-time motorsport sponsor, including MotoGP.

Securing Energy for Europe (SEFE) is the German state-owned energy trading and gas supplier, formerly Gazprom Germania, placed under German trusteeship in 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine and nationalised. Headquartered in Berlin, it buys and sells gas, power and LNG for municipal utilities and industrial customers across Europe, and holds storage and infrastructure assets. Revenue is tens of billions of euros. B2B energy trader with no consumer brand awareness.

Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company (Transco) is the Houston-based interstate natural gas pipeline owned by Williams Companies (NYSE: WMB), running about 10,000 miles from south Texas to New York City and carrying roughly 15 percent of US gas demand. Customers are utilities, power generators and industrial buyers on regulated tariffs. B2B infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness.

Whitecap Resources is a Canadian oil and gas producer based in Calgary, producing about 370,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day after acquiring Veren in 2025, with assets in Alberta, Saskatchewan and British Columbia. Listed on the TSX (WCP), with a strong dividend profile. Customers are refiners and gas buyers, so B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

Ithaca Energy is an independent North Sea oil and gas producer based in Aberdeen, producing about 100,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day from fields such as Captain, Alba, Erskine and Cygnus, and listed on the London Stock Exchange (ITH) since 2022. Delek Group of Israel holds a majority stake. It acquired Eni's UK assets in 2024. Customers are refiners and gas buyers. B2B energy producer with no consumer brand awareness.

BlueNord is an Oslo-listed oil and gas company (Oslo Bors: BNOR), formerly Norwegian Energy Company, which now focuses on the Danish part of the North Sea after taking over Hess's interest in the Syd Arne field and the Danish Underground Consortium stakes. It sells crude and gas to refiners and traders and pays shareholder dividends. Revenue comes from production of about 25,000-30,000 barrels a day. B2B, with little consumer awareness.

about: Energy Development Oman (EDO) is a Muscat-based oil and gas company, owned by the Omani state, which holds a stake in Block 61 (the Khazzan and Ghazeer gas fields) alongside BP and has other upstream interests. Revenue comes from gas and condensate sales, mostly to the domestic market. Customers are Omani utilities and industry, not consumers. Funding shown is about $2 billion. B2B energy producer with little public brand profile. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: Energy Development Oman operates as an energy company.

about: Eurowind Energy is a Danish developer, owner and operator of wind and solar power projects, based in Hobro, Jutland, with activities across Europe including Denmark, Germany, Poland and Spain. Revenue comes from electricity sales and from developing and selling energy projects, with total funding of about 2.2 billion. Customers are utilities and grid buyers rather than consumers. B2B brand with low public awareness.

about: Vista Energy is an Argentine oil and gas producer headquartered in Buenos Aires, with operations in Neuquen in the Vaca Muerta shale formation, founded in 2017 by Miguel Galuccio, ex-YPF chief. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (VIST) and the Mexican exchange, with output of about 100,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. Revenue comes from selling oil and gas, mostly in Argentina and some exports. B2B, with low consumer visibility.

Algonquin Power & Utilities is a Canadian company in Oakville, Ontario, listed on the Toronto and New York exchanges (AQN), which owns regulated water, gas and electric utilities in the US through Liberty Utilities and renewable energy projects. It sells services to residential and commercial customers in several US states and earns regulated returns and power sales. It has been refocusing on regulated utilities and selling renewables assets. B2B and local utility brand, with low national profile.

Antero Resources is a Denver-based independent natural gas and natural gas liquids producer, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (AR), with operations in the Appalachian Basin in West Virginia and Ohio. It sells gas, propane, butane and oil to utilities, industrial users and exporters, with daily output of about 3.4 billion cubic feet equivalent. B2B energy producer with little consumer brand awareness.

ARC Resources is a Calgary, Alberta oil and gas producer, listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (ARX), focused on the Montney formation in western Canada. It produces natural gas, condensate and light oil, with production of about 350,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day, and supplies LNG-linked customers through contracts. It pays dividends to shareholders. B2B, with no consumer brand profile.

BW LPG is a Singapore-headquartered owner and operator of liquefied petroleum gas carriers, part of the BW Group founded by the Sohmen family, with one of the largest very large gas carrier fleets in the world, over 40 vessels. It earns charter and freight revenue carrying LPG for oil majors, traders and Asian energy companies, and is listed in Oslo and on the New York Stock Exchange (BWLP). B2B shipping company with no consumer brand awareness.

Hallador Energy is a Terre Haute, Indiana company listed on Nasdaq (HNRG), originally a coal miner in Indiana and now also owner of the Merom coal-fired power plant after acquiring it in 2022. It sells coal to utilities and electricity to the Midwest grid, with plans to add data-centre-related power. It earns revenue from coal and power sales. B2B with low consumer awareness.

JSW Energy is a Mumbai-based power producer, part of the JSW Group (steel, cement, paints), with thermal, hydro, wind, solar and battery storage capacity in India, and is expanding in renewables and manufacturing. It sells electricity to state utilities and industrial customers, and is listed on the NSE and BSE. The funding amount is 132.5 billion rupees. B2B, though the JSW group is a well-known sponsor of Indian sport.

Liberty Oilfield Services is a Denver-based oilfield services company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (LBRT), that provides hydraulic fracturing, wireline and proppant logistics to oil and gas producers across US shale basins. It earns revenue from fracturing fleets and related services, around $4 billion a year, and has been adding digital and power generation offerings. B2B with low consumer brand awareness.

National Fuel Gas Company is a Williamsville, New York diversified energy company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NFG), with natural gas production in Appalachia via Seneca Resources, pipelines and storage, and a regulated gas utility serving western New York and Pennsylvania. Revenue is about $2 billion. Customers are gas buyers, utilities and households. Local utility brand with minimal national consumer awareness.

Serica Energy is an Aberdeen-based independent oil and gas producer listed on the London Stock Exchange (SQZ), with interests in several North Sea fields such as Bruce, Keith, Rhum and Triton, and the Erskine field. It sells gas and oil to traders and utilities and pays dividends, with output of about 40,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. B2B with no consumer brand profile.

Summit Midstream Partners is a Houston-based energy infrastructure company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (SMC), which owns and operates natural gas, crude oil and produced water gathering systems in basins in the US, including the Williston, DJ and Utica. It earns fees for moving and handling producers' output. Revenue is about 400 million dollars. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

Hafnia is a Singapore-headquartered product tanker shipping company with offices in Copenhagen, listed in Oslo and New York (HAFN), operating one of the world's largest fleets of oil product and chemical tankers, with over 100 vessels. It earns freight revenue from oil majors and traders. B2B shipping company with no consumer brand profile.

Harbour Energy is a London-based independent oil and gas company, formed from the Chrysaor and Premier Oil combination in 2021 and listed on the London Stock Exchange (HBR), the largest producer in the UK North Sea. It acquired Wintershall Dea's upstream assets in 2024, extending operations to Norway, Germany, Mexico and Argentina. Daily production is about 450,000 barrels of oil equivalent. B2B with little consumer awareness.

Murphy Oil Corporation is a Houston-based independent oil and gas exploration company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (MUR), producing about 180,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day from the US onshore, Gulf of Mexico, Canada and offshore Vietnam and Mexico. It sells crude and gas to refiners and traders. Revenue is about $3 billion. B2B; past retail gas stations were spun out to Murphy USA.

Oceaneering International is a Houston-based provider of engineered services and robotics for offshore energy, defence, aerospace and entertainment, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (OII). It operates remotely operated vehicles, subsea products and theme park ride systems, with revenue of about $2.7 billion. Customers are offshore oil majors, navies and NASA. B2B with little consumer awareness.

ONE Gas is a Tulsa, Oklahoma regulated natural gas distribution utility, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (OGS), serving over 2 million customers in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas, as Oklahoma Natural Gas, Kansas Gas Service and Texas Gas Service. Revenue is about $2.4 billion. Spun off from ONEOK in 2014. Local utility brands with no national consumer profile.

Par Pacific Holdings is a Houston-based energy company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (PARR), that owns refineries in Hawaii, Washington State, Wyoming and Montana, and retail fuel stores in Hawaii and the Pacific Northwest (76 and Hele brands). Revenue is about $7-8 billion. Customers are fuel buyers and drivers. Regional fuel brands with little national profile.

ProPetro Holding is a Midland, Texas oilfield services company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (PUMP), providing hydraulic fracturing, cementing and wireline services to oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin. Revenue is about $1.4 billion. Customers are shale operators. B2B with no consumer brand profile.

Sable Offshore is a Houston-based oil and gas company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (SOC), which acquired the Santa Ynez Unit offshore Santa Barbara, California and associated pipelines from Exxon in 2024 and seeks to restart production. It has faced strong California regulatory and legal opposition. Revenue was minimal at the time. B2B with no consumer brand.

Saturn Oil & Gas is a Calgary-based oil and gas producer, listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (SOIL), focused on light oil in Saskatchewan and Alberta, grown by acquisitions including Oxbow and Ridgeback in 2022-2023. Output is about 40,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. B2B with no consumer brand profile.

Scottish-headquartered British energy company in Perth, with major businesses in renewables, networks, thermal power and energy supply. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (SSE) and a FTSE 100 member. Serves millions of UK and Irish customers. Consumer-facing brand with high UK awareness; it has sponsored sports and the COP26 conference.

Ovintiv is a North American independent oil and natural gas producer based in Denver, Colorado, with operations in the Permian, Montney and Anadarko basins, formed from the Encana redomicile in 2020, and it acquired Black Swan Energy assets in 2025. It sells crude, NGLs and gas to refiners and marketers. Listed on the NYSE and Toronto Stock Exchange (OVV). Large upstream producer but B2B, with little consumer brand visibility.

Ras Laffan Petrochemicals is a joint venture in Qatar, owned by QatarEnergy, Chevron Phillips Chemical and others (QatarEnergy holds the majority), developing a world-scale ethane cracker and polyethylene complex at Ras Laffan Industrial City, near Doha. It is aimed at producing polyethylene for global export. Crunchbase shows about $4.4 billion in funding. State-linked, B2B industrial project with no consumer brand.

about: VARO Energy (shown as VAROPreem) is a Cham, Switzerland energy company specialising in refining conventional fuels and marketing them, per Crunchbase, with about $3.3 billion in funding shown. VARO Energy is a energy group originally formed by Vitol and Carlyle, with refining, storage, retail fuels and bioenergy in Europe. Privately held, mostly B2B, with limited consumer visibility. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: VAROPreem specializes in refining conventional fuels an...

about: CK Hutchison Holdings is a Hong Kong conglomerate founded by Li Ka-shing, with ports (Hutchison Ports), retail (A.S. Watson, with Watsons and Superdrug), infrastructure (UK Power Networks, Northumbrian Water), telecom (Three, Hutchison) and energy investments, in about 50 countries with 300,000 employees. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0001). Watsons and Superdrug are consumer brands, though the group itself is B2B.

Coterra Energy is a Houston-based independent oil and gas producer formed in 2021 by the merger of Cabot Oil & Gas and Cimarex Energy, with natural gas in the Marcellus Shale of Pennsylvania and oil in the Permian Basin and Anadarko Basin. Customers are utilities, pipelines and marketers. Listed on the NYSE (CTRA). Large upstream producer, B2B, with no consumer brand.

DNO is a Norwegian oil and gas operator headquartered in Oslo, with operations in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (Tawke), the North Sea, via its acquisition of Faroe Petroleum, and Africa and the Middle East, focused on fast-return assets. Listed on Oslo Bors (DNO). Customers are oil buyers and traders. Mid-sized upstream producer with revenue in the low billions. B2B, no consumer brand.

EnLink Midstream is a Dallas-based midstream company that gathers, processes, transports and fractionates natural gas, NGLs and crude oil in the Permian, Oklahoma, North Texas and Louisiana. Customers are producers and refiners. It was a NYSE-listed company (ENLC); ONEOK agreed to acquire it in 2024, with the deal completing in January 2025. B2B energy infrastructure with no consumer brand.

Petroperu is Peru's state-owned oil company, headquartered in Lima, running the Talara refinery (modernised at great cost), pipelines and fuel distribution, selling fuels to wholesalers and its Petroperu-branded retail stations across Peru. Wholly owned by the Peruvian state, with financial difficulties and government support in recent years. Crunchbase shows about $2.5 billion in funding. Recognisable brand in Peru, with past sponsorship of Peruvian sport and culture.

Antero Midstream is a Denver, Colorado midstream company, formed in 2019 by merging Antero Midstream Partners and Antero Midstream GP, that provides gathering, compression, processing and water services to Antero Resources in the Appalachian Basin (Marcellus and Utica shales). Listed on the NYSE (AM). Customers are essentially Antero Resources. B2B infrastructure, no consumer brand.

Apraava Energy is an Indian power company formed from CLP India, rebranded in 2022 and jointly owned by CLP Group (Hong Kong) and CDPQ (Canada), with wind, solar, thermal and transmission assets in India and a base in Mumbai. Customers are state utilities and commercial buyers. Crunchbase shows about $1.6 billion in funding. B2B energy producer, little consumer brand awareness.

about: Boardwalk Pipeline Partners is a Houston-based owner and operator of natural gas and liquids pipelines and storage, with about 14,000 miles of pipeline linking Gulf Coast producers to Midwest and Northeast markets. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Loews Corporation (NYSE: L). Customers are producers, utilities and marketers. B2B energy infrastructure, with no consumer visibility.

Chord Energy is a Houston-based oil and gas producer focused on the Williston Basin of North Dakota, formed through the 2022 merger of Oasis Petroleum and Whiting Petroleum and expanded by buying Enerplus in 2024. It sells crude to refiners and marketers. Listed on Nasdaq (CHRD). B2B, with no consumer brand.

EnQuest is an independent oil and gas development and production company based in Aberdeen, Scotland (with London roots), operating UK North Sea assets such as the Magnus field and the Sullom Voe terminal, and holding interests in Malaysia and Dubai. It sells crude to traders and refiners. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (ENQ) and in Stockholm. B2B with modest consumer visibility.

NTPC (National Thermal Power Corporation) is India's largest power company, state-controlled and headquartered in New Delhi, operating thermal, hydro, solar and wind plants with installed capacity of about 80 GW, and moving into renewables via NTPC Green Energy. Listed on NSE and BSE (NTPC) with the government owning around half. Customers are state electricity boards. B2B but a well-known national name in India.

NexGen Energy is a Vancouver-based Canadian uranium development company advancing the Rook I project in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, including the high-grade Arrow deposit, listed on the NYSE (NXE) and Toronto Stock Exchange. Pre-revenue, it plans to sell uranium to utilities. Crunchbase shows about $1.6 billion in funding. Mining developer, B2B, with no consumer brand.
